== Opening Blessing ==
We come together to do the work, as we do every Sunday whenever possible.  We disregard any feelings of being inadequate for the work or momentary belief that it’s all pointless.  In perseverance is our only chance to make a difference in the world.  --Blessed Be

== August event ==
* Brandon moves we rename it to the Shiny Green Festival, in case people find the "Tribal" concept offputting
* Ben wonders whether we should do flyers
* We have to decide 1 day vs. 3 days by July 8
** Brandon: we should probably keep the room for 3 days
** Ben: we have a fair amount of resources built up in my virtual account
*** Brandon: we're planning to build up the amount we contribute again soon
** Eric: but if we're saving up for other big things, and this doesn't look like it's going to be a big event with a lot of attendees, maybe we shouldn't be spending that much
*** Brandon: I agree, but I think there's still time to turn it into something we would want (with mostly local people)
*** Eric: That would be cool, but you've been trying for a while and haven't come back with reports of people planning to come
*** Brandon: Actually I haven't been trying very hard … I want to cast the net wider and see where we are by July 8
**** If we have 20 people (including kids) who say they're coming, that will be a clear "go" for keeping the room for 3 days … meaning we need 14 other than us
